# API reference

Every name that `import pyropdf` exports, grouped by topic. Signatures and
descriptions come from the package itself. Each topic's page gives every
method and property of its classes with its full description.

## [Documents](documents.md)

- [`Document`](documents.md#document): A PDF document.
- [`open`](documents.md#open): Open a PDF from a file path or from the bytes of a document.
- [`Probe`](documents.md#probe): What `probe` reads without loading the whole document.
- [`probe`](documents.md#probe_1): Read the page count, version, encryption, and metadata without loading the whole document.

## [Metadata](metadata.md)

- [`Metadata`](metadata.md#metadata_1): The document's Info dictionary as a live mapping, as `doc.metadata` returns it.
- [`parse_pdf_date`](metadata.md#parse_pdf_date): Return the moment of a PDF date string, or `None` when it is not one.
- [`pdf_date`](metadata.md#pdf_date): Return `moment` as a PDF date string, such as `"D:20240101120000Z"`; a naive moment is UTC.

## [Page labels](page-labels.md)

- [`PageLabelRange`](page-labels.md#pagelabelrange): The labels of the pages from `start` up to the next range.
- [`PageLabelStyle`](page-labels.md#pagelabelstyle): How a page-label range numbers its pages (`/S`, ISO 32000-2 table 161).

## [Images](images.md)

- [`ImageRewriteReport`](images.md#imagerewritereport): What `Document.rewrite_images` did.
- [`PageImage`](images.md#pageimage): One image that a page paints: its content item and its place among the page's images.
- [`StoredImage`](images.md#storedimage): An image's data as the document stores it, for an image filter that a file format holds.

## [Layers](layers.md)

- [`Layer`](layers.md#layer): An optional content group (`/Type /OCG`) and its state in the default configuration.
- [`LayerConfig`](layers.md#layerconfig): An optional content configuration: the default `/D` at index 0, then each of `/Configs`.
- [`Layers`](layers.md#layers_1): The optional content groups of a document, in `/OCGs` order; empty without optional content.

## [Sanitizing](sanitizing.md)

- [`SanitizeReport`](sanitizing.md#sanitizereport): What `Document.sanitize` removed, and what the result invalidates.

## [Fonts](fonts.md)

- [`SubsetFont`](fonts.md#subsetfont): One font program that `Document.subset_fonts` subset.

## [Pages](pages.md)

- [`Page`](pages.md#page): A page of a document, named by its page object.
- [`Pages`](pages.md#pages_1): The pages of a document, in order.

## [Drawing](drawing.md)

- [`Canvas`](drawing.md#canvas): Drawing on one page in paint order, written as one content stream.
- [`PathBuilder`](drawing.md#pathbuilder): Geometry for `Canvas.path` and `Canvas.clip`, built from segments.

## [Text and content](text-and-content.md)

- [`BlendMode`](text-and-content.md#blendmode): A blend mode of ISO 32000-2 §11.3.5.
- [`Block`](text-and-content.md#block): A block of lines of a `Layout`; `text` joins the lines with newlines.
- [`Char`](text-and-content.md#char): One glyph of a `Span`, from `Page.layout` with `chars=True`.
- [`Chars`](text-and-content.md#chars): The chars of a page as columns, from `Page.chars` and `Layout.chars`.
- [`Clip`](text-and-content.md#clip): A clipping path in display space.
- [`ClosePath`](text-and-content.md#closepath): Close the current subpath with a line to its start.
- [`Color`](text-and-content.md#color): A solid paint, as the sRGB color and alpha that hayro converts it to.
- [`Content`](text-and-content.md#content): The items that a page paints, in paint order.
- [`ContentItem`](text-and-content.md#contentitem)
- [`CurveTo`](text-and-content.md#curveto): Draw a cubic Bézier curve to `to` with two control points.
- [`FillRule`](text-and-content.md#fillrule): The rule that decides which areas a path fills or clips.
- [`FontRef`](text-and-content.md#fontref): The font that a text run uses, as hayro reads its font program.
- [`Glyph`](text-and-content.md#glyph): One glyph of a text run.
- [`GraphicsContext`](text-and-content.md#graphicscontext): The clips, transparency groups, and marked content around an item.
- [`Image`](text-and-content.md#image): An image painted on the page.
- [`ImageMask`](text-and-content.md#imagemask): The kind of mask that an image dictionary names.
- [`Layout`](text-and-content.md#layout): The text of a page as blocks, lines, spans, and, on request, characters.
- [`Line`](text-and-content.md#line): A line of a `Block`.
- [`LineCap`](text-and-content.md#linecap): The shape at the open ends of a stroke.
- [`LineJoin`](text-and-content.md#linejoin): The shape at the corners of a stroke.
- [`LineTo`](text-and-content.md#lineto): Draw a line to `to`.
- [`MarkedContent`](text-and-content.md#markedcontent): A marked-content sequence (`BMC` or `BDC`).
- [`MoveTo`](text-and-content.md#moveto): Start a new subpath at `to`.
- [`Paint`](text-and-content.md#paint)
- [`Path`](text-and-content.md#path): A path that is filled, stroked, or both.
- [`Segment`](text-and-content.md#segment)
- [`ShadingPattern`](text-and-content.md#shadingpattern): A paint that a shading fills, from a shading pattern or `sh`.
- [`ShadingType`](text-and-content.md#shadingtype): A shading type of ISO 32000-2 §8.7.4.5.
- [`SoftMask`](text-and-content.md#softmask): A soft mask: the transparency group that masks what it encloses.
- [`SoftMaskType`](text-and-content.md#softmasktype): What a soft mask reads from its group: alpha or luminosity.
- [`Span`](text-and-content.md#span): A run of text in one font, size, paint, and render mode within a `Line`.
- [`Stroke`](text-and-content.md#stroke): How a path or text run is stroked, in display space.
- [`Table`](text-and-content.md#table): A table that `Page.tables` detected, in display space.
- [`TableDiagnostics`](text-and-content.md#tablediagnostics): The geometric evidence for one detected table.
- [`TextRenderMode`](text-and-content.md#textrendermode): How a text run paints its glyphs.
- [`TextRun`](text-and-content.md#textrun): The glyphs that one text-showing operator paints.
- [`TilingPattern`](text-and-content.md#tilingpattern): A paint that repeats a pattern cell.
- [`TransparencyGroup`](text-and-content.md#transparencygroup): A transparency group and what it applies to everything inside it.
- [`Unmapped`](text-and-content.md#unmapped)
- [`Word`](text-and-content.md#word): One word of `Page.words`, in reading order.

## [OCR](ocr.md)

- [`OcrEngine`](ocr.md#ocrengine): Reusable, pure-Rust PP-OCR engine.
- [`OcrRotation`](ocr.md#ocrrotation)
- [`OcrWord`](ocr.md#ocrword): One recognized word: its text, its box, and the engine's confidence from 0 to 1.

## [Rendering](rendering.md)

- [`Colorspace`](rendering.md#colorspace): The color space of a `Pixmap`'s samples.
- [`Pixmap`](rendering.md#pixmap): A rendered page: immutable pixels, row by row from the top, RGB or gray, each with or without straight alpha, 8 bits per channel.

## [Annotations](annotations.md)

- [`Annotation`](annotations.md#annotation): A handle on one annotation of a page, as `page.annotations` lists it.
- [`AnnotationFlags`](annotations.md#annotationflags_1): Annotation `/F` flags (ISO 32000-2 Table 167); the values are pymupdf's `PDF_ANNOT_IS_*`.
- [`Annotations`](annotations.md#annotations_1): The annotations of a page other than links and form widgets, as `page.annotations` returns them.
- [`AnnotationSpecification`](annotations.md#annotationspecification)
- [`AnnotationType`](annotations.md#annotationtype_1): Annotation types by `/Subtype`; the values are pymupdf's `PDF_ANNOT_*` codes.
- [`AttachmentIcon`](annotations.md#attachmenticon): The icon of a file attachment, `/Name` (ISO 32000-2 §12.5.6.15).
- [`Border`](annotations.md#border): The border of an annotation: its line width, style, and dash pattern.
- [`BorderStyle`](annotations.md#borderstyle): The style of an annotation's border, `/BS /S` (ISO 32000-2 Table 168).
- [`Circle`](annotations.md#circle): An ellipse inscribed in a rectangle, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Highlight`](annotations.md#highlight): A highlight over text, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Ink`](annotations.md#ink): Freehand strokes, each through one or more display points, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`LineAnnotation`](annotations.md#lineannotation): A straight line between two display points, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`LineEnding`](annotations.md#lineending): The shape at an end of a line or polyline, `/LE` (ISO 32000-2 Table 179).
- [`MarkupRects`](annotations.md#markuprects)
- [`Note`](annotations.md#note): A note shown as an icon, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`NoteIcon`](annotations.md#noteicon): The icon of a note, `/Name` (ISO 32000-2 §12.5.6.4).
- [`Polygon`](annotations.md#polygon): A closed polygon through two or more display points, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`PolyLine`](annotations.md#polyline): An open line through two or more display points, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Square`](annotations.md#square): A rectangle, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Squiggly`](annotations.md#squiggly): A wavy line under text, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`StampIcon`](annotations.md#stampicon): The stamps of ISO 32000-2 §12.5.6.12, `/Name`; pymupdf's `STAMP_*` codes in their order.
- [`StrikeOut`](annotations.md#strikeout): A line through text, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Underline`](annotations.md#underline): A line under text, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.

## [Links and destinations](links-and-destinations.md)

- [`Destination`](links-and-destinations.md#destination): A place in this document: a zero-based page, a point, and a zoom.
- [`Destinations`](links-and-destinations.md#destinations): The named destinations of a document, as `doc.destinations` returns them.
- [`Launch`](links-and-destinations.md#launch): Open a file with the application the viewer associates with it.
- [`Link`](links-and-destinations.md#link): A handle on one link annotation of a page, as `page.links` lists it.
- [`Links`](links-and-destinations.md#links): The link annotations of a page, in `/Annots` order, as `page.links` returns them.
- [`NamedAction`](links-and-destinations.md#namedaction): A viewer action by name (ISO 32000-2 Table 213).
- [`RemoteDestination`](links-and-destinations.md#remotedestination): A place in another PDF file: a zero-based page or a named destination.
- [`Target`](links-and-destinations.md#target)

## [Forms and widgets](forms-and-widgets.md)

- [`CheckBox`](forms-and-widgets.md#checkbox): A check box, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`ComboBox`](forms-and-widgets.md#combobox): A drop-down choice field, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`Field`](forms-and-widgets.md#field): A handle on one terminal form field, as `doc.form[name]` returns it.
- [`FieldChoice`](forms-and-widgets.md#fieldchoice): One option of a choice field's `/Opt`.
- [`FieldFlags`](forms-and-widgets.md#fieldflags_1): The field flags of `/Ff` (ISO 32000-2 Tables 227, 229, 231, and 233).
- [`FieldSpecification`](forms-and-widgets.md#fieldspecification)
- [`FieldType`](forms-and-widgets.md#fieldtype_1): The kind of a form field, from its `/FT` and the flags that refine it.
- [`Form`](forms-and-widgets.md#form): The terminal fields of a document's interactive form, as `doc.form` returns them.
- [`ListBox`](forms-and-widgets.md#listbox): A list of choices, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`PushButton`](forms-and-widgets.md#pushbutton): A pushbutton, which holds no value, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`RadioButton`](forms-and-widgets.md#radiobutton): One button of a radio group, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`Scripts`](forms-and-widgets.md#scripts): The JavaScript of a field or widget by trigger, as `field.scripts` and `widget.scripts` return them.
- [`ScriptTrigger`](forms-and-widgets.md#scripttrigger): When a viewer runs a form script: the field triggers of `field.scripts`, the widget ones of `widget.scripts`.
- [`SignatureField`](forms-and-widgets.md#signaturefield): An unsigned signature field, which a signing tool such as pyHanko fills, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`SignatureFlags`](forms-and-widgets.md#signatureflags): The signature flags of the AcroForm's `/SigFlags` (ISO 32000-2 Table 225), which signing tools set.
- [`TextField`](forms-and-widgets.md#textfield): A text field, or another widget of the text field of that name, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`Widget`](forms-and-widgets.md#widget): A handle on one form widget of a page, as `page.widgets` lists it.
- [`Widgets`](forms-and-widgets.md#widgets): The form widgets of a page, as `page.widgets` returns them, in `/Annots` order.

## [Outline](outline.md)

- [`Outline`](outline.md#outline_1): The document's outline as its top-level items, as `doc.outline` returns it.
- [`OutlineEntry`](outline.md#outlineentry): One item of an outline to write, as `doc.outline = [...]` takes it.
- [`OutlineItem`](outline.md#outlineitem): A handle on one item of the outline, as `doc.outline` yields it.

## [Attachments](attachments.md)

- [`Attachment`](attachments.md#attachment): A handle on one embedded file of a document, as `doc.attachments[name]` returns it.
- [`Attachments`](attachments.md#attachments_1): The embedded files of a document, keyed by name, as `doc.attachments` returns them.

## [History and changes](history-and-changes.md)

- [`ChangeReport`](history-and-changes.md#changereport): What the edits since opening invalidate, for a save that is incremental or not.
- [`ClaimChange`](history-and-changes.md#claimchange): A PDF/A or PDF/UA claim of the metadata that the edits break.
- [`History`](history-and-changes.md#history): The line of steps that undo and redo walk (DESIGN.md section 4.1).
- [`SignatureChange`](history-and-changes.md#signaturechange): A signature of the opened file that the edits or the save mode invalidate.
- [`Transaction`](history-and-changes.md#transaction): A group of edits that commits as one version and one undo step.

## [Encryption](encryption.md)

- [`Access`](encryption.md#access): What a password opened: the user's restricted access, or the owner's full access.
- [`Encryption`](encryption.md#encryption_1): How `Document.save` and `Document.to_bytes` encrypt a full save.
- [`Permissions`](encryption.md#permissions): What an encrypted document permits the user password, combined with `|`.

## [Signing](signing.md)

- [`Signer`](signing.md#signer): A signing key or callback, with its certificate chain, which `Document.sign` signs with.

## [Limits and errors](limits-and-errors.md)

- [`CancellationToken`](limits-and-errors.md#cancellationtoken): A flag that stops the operations of every document whose limits carry it.
- [`DocumentClosedError`](limits-and-errors.md#documentclosederror): An operation on a closed document.
- [`DocumentLimits`](limits-and-errors.md#documentlimits): Optional budgets for opening and reading PDFs.
- [`EncryptedDocumentError`](limits-and-errors.md#encrypteddocumenterror): An operation on an encrypted document that needs a password.
- [`LimitError`](limits-and-errors.md#limiterror): A refusal by a limit, whose `code` names the limit.
- [`MalformedPdfError`](limits-and-errors.md#malformedpdferror): Input that cannot be read as a PDF document, including empty input.
- [`OcrError`](limits-and-errors.md#ocrerror): OCR model loading or inference failed.
- [`PasswordError`](limits-and-errors.md#passworderror): A password that matches neither the user password nor the owner password.
- [`PdfError`](limits-and-errors.md#pdferror): The base class of the errors that pyropdf raises for a document.
- [`PyropdfWarning`](limits-and-errors.md#pyropdfwarning): A recoverable condition of reading a PDF, such as glyphs that text extraction left out.
- [`StaleObjectError`](limits-and-errors.md#staleobjecterror): Use of a handle whose object the current version no longer has.
- [`StalePageError`](limits-and-errors.md#stalepageerror): Use of a `Page` whose page object the page tree no longer lists.

## [Content operations](content-operations.md)

- [`InlineImage`](content-operations.md#inlineimage): An inline image: its dictionary, keyed by name text as written, and its data.
- [`Operation`](content-operations.md#operation): One content-stream operation: an operator and its operands.
- [`Operations`](content-operations.md#operations): An immutable sequence of content-stream operations.

## [Objects](objects.md)

- [`Array`](objects.md#array): A PDF array; elements resolve and write as `Dictionary` values do.
- [`Dictionary`](objects.md#dictionary): A PDF dictionary keyed by name text without the slash.
- [`Name`](objects.md#name): A PDF name, such as `/Type`, held without its leading slash.
- [`Objects`](objects.md#objects_1): The indirect objects of a document, keyed by object number.
- [`Real`](objects.md#real): A PDF real: a `float` that keeps the digits it is written with.
- [`Stream`](objects.md#stream): A PDF stream: its dictionary, plus `read` and `write`.
- [`String`](objects.md#string): A PDF string: its bytes, with `text` decoding a text string.

## [Geometry](geometry.md)

- [`IRect`](geometry.md#irect): An immutable integer rectangle `(x0, y0, x1, y1)`.
- [`Matrix`](geometry.md#matrix): An immutable affine matrix `(a, b, c, d, e, f)`.
- [`Point`](geometry.md#point): An immutable point `(x, y)` in display coordinates.
- [`Quad`](geometry.md#quad): An immutable quadrilateral of four corner points `(ul, ur, ll, lr)`.
- [`Rect`](geometry.md#rect): An immutable rectangle `(x0, y0, x1, y1)` in display coordinates.

## [Checks and profiles](checks-and-profiles.md)

- [`OutputIntent`](checks-and-profiles.md#outputintent): One entry of the catalog's `/OutputIntents`.
- [`Profiles`](checks-and-profiles.md#profiles): The profile claims of a document's XMP metadata, and its output intents.
- [`StructuralDefect`](checks-and-profiles.md#structuraldefect): One departure of the document from the model.
- [`StructuralReport`](checks-and-profiles.md#structuralreport): What the structural check found.

## [Typed objects](typed-objects.md)

- [`typed`](typed-objects.md#pyropdftyped): Typed views of PDF objects, one per object type of the Arlington PDF Model.
